source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Larry — I went through the finalized BOM and everything is looking really solid. I like the direction a lot and I think we’re very close to locking this in.

I just had a few quick things I wanted to confirm before I move forward with ordering parts:

• Motors — I noticed the listing mentions an eccentric output shaft. Just want to confirm that this will still give us a smooth, centered rotation for the whisk, or if we should consider a straight/centered shaft for better stability.

• Motor performance — I like the move to 3000 RPM for flexibility. I just want to make sure we’ll be able to dial it in for smooth mixing and avoid overly aggressive splashing at higher speeds.

• Solenoid flow — since we’re using on/off valves, do you expect the pour to be smooth when opening, or will it release too abruptly? I want to make sure we get a clean, controlled pour without splashing.

• Power supply — with both motors, solenoids, and fans running, are we comfortably within the limits of the 12V 20A power supply under load?

• Splash control — with the higher RPM, I just want to confirm that whisk positioning, bowl depth, and overall layout will keep things clean during operation. I want this to be as splash-proof and mess-free as possible for events.

Everything else looks great to me — just want to make sure we’re fully dialed in on these before the order is placed.

Let me know your thoughts.

pre_order_compatibility_checks: motor shaft and coupling selection must support smooth centered whisk rotation
solenoid valve and outlet selection must support smooth, controlled, non-abrupt, splash-free flow
electrical component ratings must support both motors, solenoids, and fans under load

decisions.reason: The dispensing-flow refinement does not alter the existing V1 sourcing policy or its custom-spout exception.
